title: The Vulnerability Window: Decision Instability in Quantized Reward Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.27155v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reward models and LLM judges are routinely quantized to 4 bits so that scoring many candidates stays affordable, and the usual check is that benchmark accuracy barely moves. That check is close to blind. Across eight reward models from two families (0.6B-8B), three generative judges and four 4-bit quantizers, quantization rewrites 1.1-12.3% of pairwise preference decisions on RewardBench while aggregate accuracy moves by as little as 0.03 points (p = 1.00), because the errors it fixes and introduces cancel. Flips concentrate where the full-precision margin is small relative to the quantization noise scale sigma: a Gaussian approximation Phi(-|m|/sigma) describes the aggregate rate, over-predicting it in all 30 scalar settings and failing for generative judges, and occupancy of the resulting vulnerability window falls from 25% to 7% with model size, which is what makes small judges fragile. The churn stays within noise under benign best

translated_title: 脆弱性窗口：量化奖励模型中的决策不稳定性
translated_abstract: 奖励模型和大语言模型裁判通常被量化到4比特，以便在为大量候选打分时保持成本可控，而常规的验证方式是确认基准测试准确率几乎不变。这种验证方式近乎盲目。在来自两个系列的八个奖励模型（0.6B-8B）、三个生成式裁判以及四种4比特量化方法上，量化会改写RewardBench上1.1-12.3%的成对偏好决策，而总体准确率的变化却小至0.03分（p = 1.00），这是因为量化所修复的错误与其引入的错误相互抵消。决策翻转集中在全精度边际相对于量化噪声尺度sigma较小时的位置：高斯近似Phi(-|m|/sigma)能够描述总体翻转率，但在所有30个标量设置中都会高估该比率，并且对生成式裁判失效；由此产生的脆弱性窗口的占比随模型规模的增大从25%降至7%，这正是小型裁判脆弱的原因。在良性最佳情况下，这种变动保持在噪声范围内……
tldr: 量化在总体基准准确率几乎不变的情况下仍会翻转1.1-12.3%的奖励模型成对偏好决策，其翻转率可用高斯近似Φ(-|m|/σ)刻画，且脆弱性窗口占比随模型规模从25%降至7%，揭示了小型裁判尤其脆弱的隐患。
en_tdlr: Quantization silently flips 1.1-12.3% of pairwise preference decisions in reward models while aggregate accuracy barely moves; flip rates follow a Gaussian approximation Φ(-|m|/σ), and the vulnerability window shrinks from 25% to 7% with model size, exposing the fragility of small judges.
